confirmed_harness_pairings.config: opencode.json, global config dir (C:\Users\ottopoet-thesean\.config\opencode\opencode.json) -- project-directory-relative config was tried first and did NOT reliably apply (the OpenCode session's own reported 'directory' did not match the shell's cwd at invocation time), global config avoids that.
confirmed_harness_pairings.real_lesson: --ctx-size 8192 was too small for OpenCode's own agentic scaffolding overhead alone (~9,700+ tokens of system prompt/tool definitions before any real task content) -- caused a genuine context-overflow retry loop, not a model or harness bug. Fixed by relaunching with --ctx-size 32768 (model's own native training context is 262144, plenty of headroom). Any future harness pairing should default to a large context window from the start, not the smallest one that fit a bare chat test.
